capabilities: Long-range open-vocabulary object search in unstructured outdoor environments
Combines geometric and visual reasoning via vision-scored navigation graph

new_sections.System Overview: WildOS consists of five main components: Navigation Graph Construction, ExploRFM vision module, Frontier Scoring, Goal Triangulation, and Planner. It builds a sparse navigation graph, scores frontier nodes with visual information from ExploRFM, and uses a particle filter to localize distant goals.
new_sections.Problem Formulation: Addresses long-range object search in large-scale unstructured environments. Robot with RGB camera and LiDAR must locate object specified by natural language query Qgoal. No prior map. Objective to minimize navigation cost to reach target within reachability distance dreach.

capabilities: Jointly predicts traversability, visual frontiers, and object similarity in image space
Enables scoring of frontier nodes for semantic navigation

new_sections.Role: ExploRFM is the vision module that scores frontier nodes of the navigation graph by predicting visual frontiers, traversability, and similarity to the target query.

parameters.purpose: estimate candidate goal positions for open-vocabulary target

capabilities: Localizes open-vocabulary goal objects beyond the robot's depth sensing range
Enables goal-aware planning toward distant visual cues
Coarse localization, not precise metric mapping

new_sections.Description: A particle-filter-based approach to estimate 3D goal location from multiple views of the target object when depth is unavailable. Provides coarse position for planning.

parameters.definition: Regions in image space that appear navigable and extend beyond the depth horizon
parameters.compared_to: Geometric frontiers at boundary of known space

capabilities: Rich visual cues about open regions or affordable gaps
Enables semantically-informed exploration beyond LiDAR range

new_sections.Concept: Visual frontiers are image regions that indicate likely traversable paths, identified by foundation models to guide exploration direction.

capabilities: Maintains spatial memory of explored regions
Prioritizes exploration toward visually promising regions
Combines geometric safety with long-range semantic awareness

new_sections.Description: A graph-based topological map where nodes are scored with visual information from ExploRFM, enabling semantic-aware exploration while retaining geometric safety.

capabilities: Search for objects described in natural language without prior map or predefined categories

new_sections.Definition: Task of locating a target object specified by a natural language query in an unknown environment using onboard sensing.
